name: Lab Result
query:
SELECT
    L.date AS "Date",
    L.patient AS "PID",
    L.patient_name AS "Name:Data:250",
    L.lab_ref,
    Lt.lab_test_name AS "Test Name:Data:150",
    Lt.result_value AS "Result:Data:100"
FROM
    `tabLab Result` L
JOIN
    `tabNormal Test Result` Lt ON Lt.parent = L.name
WHERE
    L.date BETWEEN %(from)s AND %(to)s
    AND L.docstatus = 1
    AND (Lt.lab_test_name IS NOT NULL AND Lt.lab_test_name != '')
GROUP BY
    L.date, L.patient, L.patient_name, Lt.lab_test_name, Lt.result_value;
